description: User identity — signup, login, session management, and account recovery.

screens_added.name: Splash / Launch
screens_added.purpose: Auth state check — redirect to login or home

flows_added: Email signup → verify email → profile setup → home
Forgot password → email sent → reset link → new password → login
interaction_patterns: Biometric login — Face ID or fingerprint on return visit
Social login buttons — Google and Apple always above the fold
OTP input — 6 digits, auto-advance on each digit
Magic link — single CTA, no password required
Session timeout warning — modal with extend or logout

error_flows.ui: Inline error below password field: 'Incorrect password'. Field border red. Password field cleared. After 3 failed attempts: 'Too many attempts — try again in 30 seconds'. Countdown timer shown. Never lock permanently on first session.
Inline error: 'No account found with this email'. Do NOT confirm whether email exists if security-sensitive — show generic 'Email or password incorrect' instead. Context-dependent.
Red border on OTP input. Message: 'Invalid or expired code'. Resend CTA appears immediately. Countdown resets. Previous entry cleared. Never leave user stranded without resend option.
Toast: 'Sign in with [Provider] failed'. Fallback CTA: 'Continue with email instead'. Never show raw OAuth error codes to user. Log internally.
Modal overlay: 'Your session has expired'. CTA: 'Log in again'. Preserve current page state where possible — user returns to same screen after re-auth. Never silently redirect to home.

error_flows.trigger: Account already exists with same email
error_flows.ui: On signup: 'An account with this email already exists'. CTA: 'Log in instead'. Pre-fill email on login screen. Do not allow duplicate accounts.

edge_cases.case: User switches between social and email login for same account
edge_cases.ui: Detect email match — prompt to link accounts: 'You previously signed in with Google. Link your accounts?' Confirm before merging. Never create duplicate account silently.

edge_cases.case: Biometric not set up on device
edge_cases.ui: Biometric option hidden — never shown as disabled or greyed. Fall back to PIN or password without mentioning biometric unavailability.

edge_cases.case: User enters email with typo (e.g. .con instead of .com)
edge_cases.ui: Inline suggestion: 'Did you mean [corrected email]?' Shown immediately on blur, not on submit. Tap to accept correction.
Show: 'This reset link has already been used or has expired'. CTA: 'Request a new reset link'. Never show a blank or error page.

edge_cases.case: User is already logged in on another device
edge_cases.ui: On login: 'You are already signed in on another device. Continue here?' Options: 'Sign in here' (logs out other device) or 'Cancel'. Make the consequence explicit.

edge_cases.case: Magic link clicked on different device than requested
edge_cases.ui: Show warning: 'This link was opened on a different device'. Options: 'Continue anyway' or 'Request a new link'. Do not auto-approve cross-device without acknowledgement.
